camera.shot_scale_bias: precise medium shots with generous headroom control

lens.dof: a moderately shallow focus with a clean falloff

sources: hard sourced key from one side
lighting.practicals: shadows fall deep and stay clean, with no fill bounce

palette.grade: crushed blacks with a green-amber split

rules: exact centre or exact thirds, never approximate
composition.movement_of_subject: actors move minimally; stillness is the default

sound.ambience_bias: low electrical hum, ventilation, distant traffic behind glass

music.instrumentation: A low synthesiser drone with a repeating muted pulse
music.dynamics: rising only in volume, never in tempo

must_include: the camera holds absolutely steady with no handheld drift
the background is clean and free of incidental clutter

notes: Locked-off precision and desaturated cold colour. Movement is motivated and slow; nothing in frame is accidental.
